[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] used a '''''Munificent''-class star frigate''' as his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] at the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]]. During the the battle, the ship was destroyed when [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] flanked Grievous's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] on a [[Golm asteroid belt|belt of asteroids]], and severely damaged the fleet from behind.

==History==
[[File:Downfall-GrievousandDroid.png|thumb|left|300px|General Grievous aboard the bridge of his frigate with a battle droid pilot.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this ship lead a fleet of ''Munificent''-class star frigates to invade the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] after successfully [[Fall of Falleen|destroying]] Republic resistance on [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]. [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic naval forces]], under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], intercepted the fleet over the planet of [[Golm|Bothawui Prime]] and [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|engaged]] Grievous's forces.

Grievous sent his fleet of six [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] through the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt of the planet while the Republic fleet held its ground between Bothawui Prime and the belt. Due to the fact that his ships were protected from behind by the asteroids, Grievous ordered all power in the frigates be diverted to the [[Deflector shield/Legends|forward shields]], leaving the rear of all of the frigates without shields. Anakin Skywalker led the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] against the frigates, though the squadron retreated after losing two [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] while Anakin continued his run on the enemy frigates.

As the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] fleet advanced through the asteroid belt, [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] positioned on the asteroids fired on the unshielded sterns on the frigates. The Republic fleet's fire combined with the flanking [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] destroyed the fleet, including the command ship, while Grievous escaped the battle in his ship [[Soulless One/Legends|Soulless One]].

The command ship's debris was later picked over by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], who later found [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in the debris field.
